_doc: PROVENANCE-1 as data (owner, 2026-11-17). Every input and every change records where it came from, what it touched and what it did. Read by foundation/provenance.py, `python3 -m foundation provenance --check`, the dashboard (/changelog, /api/provenance) and doctrine/self-improvement.json (signal change-effect). Prose is never the enforcement; this file and its checker are.
axiom: PROVENANCE-1: To improve itself the system must know where it has been. Every input and every change is a row with an origin class (system, loop, owner, end_user, agent, external), an actor, a channel, what it affected and, once measured, its effect. Rows are append-only and event-sourced; a later row settles an earlier one. The public view shows only rows marked public, with contact details and secrets stripped; private detail never leaves the ledger. The improvement loops read the rows: a lever that keeps being reverted is retired, one that keeps being kept is reinforced.

origin_classes.system: started by the system itself with no loop id (bootstrap, migration, self-amendment)
origin_classes.loop: an automated code loop; actor is the loop id from instances/ultrastable/loop-registry.json
origin_classes.owner: typed or spoken by the owner (console note, project thread, command)
origin_classes.end_user: submitted by a tenant's visitor or customer (suggestion, correction, form); actor is the tenant surface, never a person
origin_classes.agent: a code agent session working a work order; actor is the agent name
origin_classes.external: a signal from outside (scout finding, funder reply, competitor change)
